Definition: enduring; a species of hard-wood or lasting tree (perhaps oak)
BiblicalUsage: Isaiah names this tree twice, both times in promises about the wilderness being planted and the sanctuary being beautified. In Isaiah 41:19 it stands among the cedar, the myrtle and the oil tree, and in Isaiah 60:13 it comes with the fir and the pine to beautify the place of God's feet.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tree matters because God chooses lasting wood for lasting work: what He plants in the desert stays, and what beautifies His house is no passing decoration.
